# Tabler inbox symbols

Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
Pinned commit: 74929e50416e2b7c0abb8368cdc74bdcb2560ab6

The outline SVGs are unmodified upstream sources, licensed under MIT (LICENSE).
The active symbols are message-dots.svg (inbox_chat), radar.svg (inbox_tracker)
and calendar.svg (inbox_daily). Their exact path data is exported by ui-icons.js.
The earlier eye.svg, target-arrow.svg and gift.svg are retained as previous variants.
The launcher renders them with the original round joins, round caps and stroke width 2.
